note: Dated supplier listing observations owned by the procurement ledger. A listing is not a reservation, quote or assembly acceptance; refresh before ordering.

observations.gaps: The saved page carries no JLC stock figure for C221842 itself (the last recorded value is stock 0 on 2026-11-09). Whether a pre-order is filled depends on LCSC stock, not observed. Global Sourcing is quote-based. presale 0 may mean a pre-order cannot be placed now. Prices are tier values with no currency field.

field_meanings.note: preMinPurchaseNum, canPresaleNumber, isBuyComponent and overseasStockCount are read from an undocumented page payload; their meanings (pre-order minimum, pre-orderable quantity, buyable, overseas stock) are our reading, not a JLC definition. preMinPurchaseNum 3 is probably the same value the 2026-11-09 observation recorded as minPurchaseNum 3.

relayed_by.how: The owner pasted a summary made by their browsing assistant from the live JLC pages. Not a first-hand capture: no page, screenshot or hash was kept.

extract: Pre-order: Offered. Minimum quantity is 3 pieces; full reel is 3,500. At quantity 3, the detail page showed an estimated $3.0325 each, $9.10 total. The search page showed ¥465.59 each, ¥1,397 total, and “Est. lead time: 31 days.” No exact arrival date was shown.
DigiKey, cut tape: ¥275.19 each, ¥826 total; 8–15 business days.
RS Components would not retain a quantity of 3: the page changed it to 10 and said “10 modified as multiples of 10 are required.”
“The purchased components are stored in your JLCPCB parts library for future PCBA orders only, and cannot be shipped separately.”

preorder_estimate.note: Shown on the detail page in USD. The search page showed JPY instead (¥465.59 each, ¥1,397 total); displayed figures, not conversions.

global_sourcing.note: Requires multiples of 10; the page changed 3 to 10.

observations.gaps: Owner-relayed summary without a stored page or hash. No exact pre-order arrival date. No discontinued, not-recommended or minimum-order-value warning was seen; that is an absence in the summary, not a JLC statement.
